roadmapTask: Horizon 13: Breaking Changes in stage/prod are accepted through Git (ADR-0015 accepted-change records). Settle what a record holds, how an Environment knows it already applied one, whether records are ever removed, and what happens if the Source has drifted again by apply time. Also cover how a Breaking Change in a PR branch is handled unattended (the accept-schema --branch gap).

Adds AcceptedChangeRecord, parse_change, load_accepted_record, dump_accepted_record, cover(). schema_snapshot.py was planned but not changed. A dropped change parses with previous_type "" (a record has no old type), so the parse test for DROPPED compares message and (column, kind), not == against the found change.
